subject: [PATCH] mm/vmscan: reclaim every zone in per-node proactive reclaim

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Similarity to existing code is noted, but author believes their patch is still correct.

reviews.author: Michal Hocko
reviews.summary: Acked the patch, but notes that tweaking the mask seems more consistent.
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue 20-10-26 15:58:53, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> On 2026-10-20 09:49 +0200, Michal Hocko wrote:
> > 
> > Would it make more sense to 
> > diff --git a/mm/vmscan.c b/mm/vmscan.c
> > index f11491ee9ed5..e07db9514e59 100644
> > --- a/mm/vmscan.c
> > +++ b/mm/vmscan.c
> > @@ -7963,7 +7963,7 @@ int user_proactive_reclaim(char *buf,
> >  	int swappiness = -1;
> >  	char *old_buf, *start;
> >  	substring_t args[MAX_OPT_ARGS];
> > -	gfp_t gfp_mask = GFP_KERNEL;
> > +	gfp_t gfp_mask = GFP_HIGHUSER_MOVABLE;
> >  
> >  	if (!buf || (!memcg && !pgdat) || (memcg && pgdat))
> >  		return -EINVAL;
> > 
> > That would take care of try_to_free_mem_cgroup_pages too.
> 
> funny enough, try_to_free_mem_cgroup_pages does what my patch does:
> 
> struct scan_control sc = {
> 	.reclaim_idx = MAX_NR_ZONES - 1,
> 
> 
> now, whether the gfp_mask should be GFP_KERNEL, that's a different
> question i think.
> 
> (tl;dr i think my patch is still correct)

Ohh, right, I forgot that memcg reclaim always reclaims all zones.
Tweaking the mask seems more consistent but not something I will insist
on. Up to you which way to go. In any case

Acked-by: Michal Hocko <mhocko@suse.com>
-- 
Michal Hocko
SUSE Labs

2026-10-20.patch_summary: Patch aims to reclaim every zone in per-node proactive reclaim, but similarity to existing code is noted.

reviews.author: SJ Park
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch does not address the issue of reclaiming movable memory, which is skipped due to the gfp_zone(GFP_KERNEL) limit in user_proactive_reclaim(), and requested that every zone be scanned as per the original proactive reclaim interface.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledges that their interface has bugs and is surprised by reviewer's feedback, but does not commit to fixing them.
reviews.raw_body:
I'm shocked, I tell you, shocked!

These are all things I accidentally ran into by just uh... using the
interface.  I'm absolutely positive these interfaces are full of bugs.

~Gregory

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the per-node proactive reclaim function to scan every zone, not just ZONE_NORMAL, in order to reclaim movable memory as well. This addresses a problem where nodes with only movable memory were not being reclaimed properly. The approach taken is to change the `reclaim_idx` field of the `scan_control` structure to always set it to the maximum number of zones, allowing all zones to be scanned.
